data.name: Bazl
data.gender_notes: Bazl is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azl' which means to 'separate' or 'detach'. This name is associated with the idea of being able to separate oneself from distractions and focusing on the essentials, leading to increased power, wisdom, and strength. The name Bazl carries the meaning “Powerful, Wise, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bazl usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, wise, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages inner strength and the ability to separate oneself from worldly distractions, enabling a deeper connection with the divine.
data.etymology: Bazl belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Wise, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bazl total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
